title: Laterality confirmed and marked for every breast and neck case
logic: If a unilateral breast or thyroid procedure is booked and the operative side is not recorded as marked and cross-checked against imaging, biopsy report, and consent, the case must not proceed to time-out completion.
action: Block operative-record progression until side-marking and three-source concordance (imaging, histology/cytology, consent) are captured; discordance escalates to the operating surgeon before anaesthesia.

title: Euthyroid state gates thyroid surgery
logic: If thyroidectomy is booked for a patient with current or previous thyrotoxicosis and no recent thyroid function result confirming euthyroid state is attached, the booking is incomplete — operating on the toxic gland risks thyroid storm.
action: Flag the booking; require a recent thyroid function result or documented endocrine/senior sign-off before the case is listed.

title: Triple assessment completes before breast cancer surgery
logic: If a breast lesion is on a surgical pathway for suspected carcinoma, it is classified surgery-ready only when clinical examination, imaging, and core needle biopsy results are all recorded and concordant, and an MDT (or documented senior surgical) decision exists; discordant triple assessment is classified unresolved.
action: Hold definitive cancer surgery listing until triple assessment concordance and a decision record exist; route discordant assessments back to the breast clinic for repeat biopsy or excision-biopsy decision.

title: Post-thyroidectomy neck swelling is an airway emergency
logic: If a patient after thyroidectomy or neck exploration develops neck swelling, wound tension, stridor, voice change with distress, or difficulty breathing, a compressive haematoma is presumed.
action: Trigger emergency response: open the wound at the bedside (skin and strap closure) without waiting for theatre if airway compromise is present, call anaesthetics and the surgeon simultaneously, and return to theatre for haemostasis; keep clip/suture removers at the bedside for 24 hours postoperatively as standing policy.

title: Non-resolving breast abscess or inflammatory change needs biopsy
logic: If a treated breast abscess or mastitis has not resolved after two aspiration/antibiotic cycles or 2 weeks, or a residual mass or persistent skin changes (peau d'orange, fixed erythema) are recorded, inflammatory carcinoma and tuberculosis are the presumptions to exclude.
action: Alert the clinician to arrange imaging plus core biopsy of the wall/mass and mycobacterial studies; block further repeat-aspiration-only plans without a biopsy decision recorded.

title: Prophylaxis proportionate to clean breast and endocrine surgery
logic: If a clean breast or thyroid procedure is booked, a single intravenous dose of cefazolin within 60 minutes before incision is appropriate where drains, implants, axillary dissection, or prolonged surgery are anticipated; minor clean excisions without these factors may proceed without prophylaxis per unit policy; abscess surgery uses treatment antibiotics targeting staphylococci instead.
action: Prompt a proportionate prophylaxis decision at induction (single dose, none-with-reason, or treatment course) and record it; flag repeated postoperative dosing after clean surgery as non-indicated.

title: Calcium surveillance after total thyroidectomy
logic: If a total or completion thyroidectomy is performed, serum calcium must be checked per protocol within the first 24 hours and before discharge, with symptom checks (perioral tingling, carpopedal spasm) each nursing shift; symptomatic or falling calcium requires replacement and endocrine-pathway escalation.
action: Auto-generate calcium blood-draw tasks and per-shift symptom checks for 48 hours; alert the team on symptomatic hypocalcaemia or a falling trend; block discharge sign-off until a calcium result and replacement plan (or explicit none-needed) are recorded.

title: Drain and seroma pathway after mastectomy
logic: If closed-suction drains are placed at mastectomy or axillary clearance, output is charted daily and drains removed per unit volume threshold; after removal, symptomatic seroma is managed by clinic aspiration, not readmission or re-operation.
action: Generate daily drain-output tasks with the removal threshold displayed; on removal, attach seroma-aspiration access instructions to the discharge plan and book the wound review.

title: Breast cancer surveillance after curative surgery
logic: If curative breast cancer surgery is complete, follow-up requires: MDT review of final histology within 4 weeks driving adjuvant therapy; clinical review 6-monthly for 5 years then annually; annual surveillance mammography of conserved/contralateral breast where imaging capacity allows; and immediate re-referral criteria (new lump, skin change, arm swelling) on the discharge summary.
action: Auto-generate the surveillance schedule at histology sign-off; flag any patient whose adjuvant decision (radiotherapy after conservation especially) has no recorded plan within 6 weeks of surgery.

title: Thyroid histology and function follow-through
logic: If any thyroid resection is performed, follow-up requires histology review with a completion-surgery decision where malignant; thyroid function testing at 6 weeks after hemithyroidectomy; and lifelong levothyroxine with periodic function testing after total thyroidectomy.
action: Open a histology-tracking task at operation coding; auto-book the 6-week function test; create the recurring levothyroxine monitoring task for total thyroidectomy patients.
